title: iPad deals UK: cheapest prices today and which iPad to buy
seoTitle: iPad Deals UK: Cheapest Prices and Which iPad to Buy
description: Today's cheapest UK prices on the iPad, iPad Air, iPad mini and iPad Pro, which model suits you, and the price worth waiting for. Checked 18 November 2026.
intro:
**The cheapest new iPad in the UK right now is the iPad (A16) 128GB at £399 on Amazon, £30 under Apple's £429 price.** That's a fair price, not a great one: Apple put iPad prices up by £100 to £200 in June 2026, and so far Black Friday discounts are small, mostly £30 to £50.

For most people the basic iPad is still the one to buy. Get the iPad Air if you want a faster chip and Apple Pencil Pro support, and the outgoing iPad mini (A17 Pro) is now £100 cheaper than its replacement. Prices were reported on 17 November 2026 from Macworld's UK price check; Amazon's Black Friday Week starts on 19 November, so check back.

body:
## Which iPad should you buy?

Apple sells four iPads. In order of price:

- **iPad (A16), from £429:** the default choice. An 11-inch screen, a chip that copes easily with streaming, video calls, schoolwork and most games, and support for the USB-C Apple Pencil. It doesn't run Apple Intelligence, which matters less than the marketing suggests.
- **iPad mini, from £699 (new A20 Pro model):** the 8.3-inch iPad. Great for reading, travel and one-handed use. The previous A17 Pro mini is still on sale for £100 less.
- **iPad Air (M4), from £749 (11-inch) or £949 (13-inch):** a much faster chip, Apple Pencil Pro and Magic Keyboard support, and a 13-inch option. Choose this if you'll draw, take handwritten notes or use it like a laptop.
- **iPad Pro (M5), from £1,199:** OLED screen, the fastest chip and the thinnest design. Brilliant, but overkill unless you edit video or create art professionally.

If you're buying for a child, a grandparent or the sofa, get the basic iPad. Spend the difference on a case and, if needed, more storage.

## What's a good price?

Apple raised UK iPad prices on 25 June 2026: the basic iPad went from £329 to £429, the iPad Air 11-inch from £599 to £749 and the iPad Pro 11-inch from £999 to £1,199. So older 'lowest ever' prices, like the basic iPad's £299, came before the rise and probably won't return.

Target prices for Black Friday:

- **iPad (A16) 128GB:** £399 is fair; **under £379 is good.**
- **iPad Air 11-inch (M4) 128GB:** anything **under £700** would be a strong deal.
- **iPad mini (A17 Pro):** the outgoing model is the one most likely to get a big cut as stock clears. **Under £499** is good.
- **iPad Pro (M5):** discounts of £100 or more are rare. Take £150 off if you were buying anyway.

Be careful with old models. One retailer was selling the 2021 iPad (10.2-inch) for £389 this week. That's almost the same money as the current A16 iPad, which has a newer chip, a bigger screen and USB-C. Skip it.

## When do iPad prices drop?

The big three dates are Amazon's Prime Day in July, Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days in October and Black Friday. Amazon's Black Friday Week runs from 19 to 30 November 2026, and Amazon usually leads on iPad prices, with John Lewis, Currys and Argos often matching. Apple's own store rarely discounts, although its Black Friday event usually offers a gift card with purchases.

See our [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) for dates and Prime tips, and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for other brands. Buying for an Apple fan? Our [AirPods Pro deals guide](/guides/airpods-pro-deals-uk/) and [Apple Watch deals guide](/guides/apple-watch-deals-uk/) have today's prices.

## iPad FAQs

### Is the basic iPad good enough?

For most people, yes. It handles streaming, browsing, email, video calls, homework and most games without trouble. You only need the Air or Pro for drawing with the Pencil Pro, heavy multitasking or video editing.

### Should I buy the Wi-Fi or cellular iPad?

Wi-Fi for almost everyone. You can share your phone's connection when you're out. Cellular models cost extra and need their own data plan.

### How much storage do I need?

128GB is enough if you mostly stream. Go for 256GB if you download a lot of films for trips, keep a big photo library on the iPad or play large games.

### Will iPads be cheaper on Black Friday?

Probably a little. Discounts so far are £30 to £50 on most models, and last year's bigger cuts came before Apple's June price rise. The outgoing iPad mini is the model most likely to see a large drop.

### Do I need Prime for Amazon's iPad deals?

Not usually, as iPad deals at Amazon are normally open to everyone. Prime still gets you free next-day delivery; our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time the trial.
